title: GreGille BETA
description: This mod adds a bunch of weirdos
body: This is a very weird mod I made. It adds OG fish back to Minecraft, Pineapples, Jeff, and a whole bunch of other stuff. Due to me sucking at making mods(Or it's just my laziness) Some Items are only obtainable through commands(ex. pineapple) and mob drops(ex. fish). PLS SHARE DIS MOD AND DOWNLOAD IT AND LIKE IT AND STUFF. I might make a revamped version one day.
